desc: Parse N and permutation P (1-indexed values for BIT convenience).
Implement a Fenwick tree class with `add` and `sum` methods, 1-indexed.
Iterate i from 0 to N-1; for each x = P[i], compute `greater = i - bit.sum(x)` (number of already seen elements > x), add `greater * (i+1)` to ans.
Consider edge cases: N up to 2e5, already sorted, reverse sorted, large values; ensure answer fits in Python int.
